'''Skifter Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Kuratooine]] in [[44 ABY]]. It was known for its [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and housed elements of [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command]].
